title: Neon Retro Arcade
specs: Classic arcade games restored to original glory including Asteroids, Donkey Kong, Pac-Man, The Simpsons, Street Fighter 2

blurb: Guests play a curated lineup of vintage arcade games restored to their original glory, including classics like Asteroids, Donkey Kong, and Pac-Man. The arcade provides a clean, welcoming environment for gamers of all ages to enjoy classic games. The game lineup rotates regularly and includes both famous classics and hidden gems.
extraNote: Neon Pasadena location, a half-block south of Colorado Blvd, near Raymond Ave and Green parking structure
